rule: ChatGPT's own page on a phone or in a browser (`login(member, 'chatgpt', { via: 'redirect' })`): the authorize request carries `authorize` exactly plus a fresh S256 `code_challenge` and `state`; OpenAI's page accepts only `returnTo` as the return address and refuses each of `refused` with `invalid_authorize_request` (seen at auth.openai.com on 2026-10-17), so the app watches its in-app browser for `returnTo` and hands the full address to `complete`. `complete` turns an address away with `SignInReturnError` and the `outcomes` code; only `expired` ends the sign-in.
